title: Bronze for Life runtime configuration
description: JSON-serializable configuration for the Bronze for Life solver. Omitted fields fall back to defaults.

json_path.description: Path to the Riot set data JSON (en_us.json).

set_id.description: Set identifier inside the set data file (e.g., '16').

metatft_txt_path.description: Optional path to MetaTFT export text used for tie-break weights.

metatft_traits_path.description: Optional path to MetaTFT trait export text used for standard mode.

team_size.description: Number of units in the final team.

beam_width.description: Search beam width; larger values improve quality at the cost of speed.

blacklist_traits_by_name.description: Traits that should never count for Bronze for Life even if active.

emblem_start_counts.description: Fixed emblem counts applied before solving (trait name -> starting count).

max_emblems_total.description: Maximum number of emblems the solver may auto-assign in addition to fixed counts.

additionalProperties.description: -1 to ban, 0 to ignore, 1 to force into the team.

required_traits_min.description: Minimum trait counts that must be satisfied after emblems (trait name -> min count).

w_win.description: Weight for MetaTFT win rate when computing unit power tie-breaks.

w_avg.description: Weight for MetaTFT average placement when computing unit power tie-breaks.

w_freq.description: Weight for MetaTFT frequency when computing unit power tie-breaks.

mode.description: Bronze for Life (bronze) or MetaTFT trait-first (standard) mode.
